### Borea v0.2.0

Borea is the community content manager for Kitten Space Agency: find mods, install them with their dependencies into separate instances of the game, and launch through StarMap.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Coming from v0.1.0

v0.1.0 cannot update itself, so download v0.2.0 from this page once.
The archive now unpacks into a folder named `Borea`. Put it where it can stay, such as `%LocalAppData%\Programs\Borea` or `~/.local/share/Borea`, because from v0.2.0 on Borea updates itself into that folder: "Update now" on the Home banner, or `borea update-self`.

#### Highlights

- Borea updates itself, in the same folder, so shortcuts keep working.
- Mod packs: create an instance from a pack, and move it to a newer or older pack version.
- Mods you installed by hand: Borea takes them over, and it notices a mod whose folder is gone.
- Saves and vehicles: backups you can restore and delete, and old ones are cleaned up.
- Discover refreshes the content index while Borea runs, and shows the dependencies of a mod.
- Share a mod with a link: every listing has a web page with "Open in Borea".
- Mod authors: list and change your mods from the App.

#### For players

##### Updating Borea

- "Update now" on the Home banner downloads the build for your system, checks it against the checksums of the release, and puts it in place of the one you run. If something fails, your build stays as it was.
- Borea removes the unpacked files of its earlier builds, which used to stay on the disk.

##### Discover and mod pages

- A Refresh button next to the heading, and a check in the background when the index is older than ten minutes.
- The foot of the side panel says how many mods the list holds, or how many of them a filter shows.
- Each Game version box clears on its own, a chosen license or system is marked, and many filter chips wrap instead of running off the edge.
- A click anywhere on a row opens its page, and a back arrow leads to where you came from.
- Discover names the instance that "+" adds to.
- The compatibility chip shows only where it differs from the rest of the list.
- A mod page has a Dependencies tab, and "Change version" leads to the versions of an installed mod. The installed version offers no "+", and replacing a version always asks first.
- The download size follows the choices you make, and an install that does not fit on the disk is refused before it starts.
- The content categories are translated.

##### Instances

- The new instance dialog explains what an instance is, and small "?" buttons explain the game profile and other things in place.
- The whole instance card opens the instance.
- The instance page shows which mod loader the instance needs, and whether the right version is installed.
- A mod whose folder is gone is marked "Not on disk", with "Install again" or "Remove from the list".
- "Let Borea manage" on the row of a mod you installed by hand takes it over, so it updates and removes like any other.
- Core loads before the mods of an instance, so a new instance starts the way the game expects.
- When the game installation does not look the way Borea expects after a KSA update, Home says so and Borea does not change mod files until it is sorted out.
- Deleting an instance also deletes its backups.
- Moving the library folder no longer asks you to close a game that does not run.

##### Mod packs

- "New instance from this pack" on the page of a pack.
- Move an instance to a newer version of its pack, or install an older one from the Versions tab.
- A pack update that stops or fails keeps the mods you had.

##### Saves and vehicles

- Backups has a list of every backup with Restore and Delete, and "Delete backups older than" in the settings.
- "Copy from profile" can select or clear every item at once.

##### Launching and when something goes wrong

- When StarMap crashes while it loads mods, Borea names the mod that was loading.
- The error bar says what you can do, with "Copy details" and "Report this".
- Settings has a Help tab that says where to ask and what to put in a report.
- A second start brings the open Borea window to the front, and `borea://` links open pages in Borea on Windows and Linux.
- The window closes even when an install does not stop.

#### For mod authors

- "List or change your mod" on Discover writes the listing of your mod, checks it as you type, and opens the pull request to the content index after you sign in to GitHub. It also loads a listed mod to change it, with a search by name, id or author.
- Every listing has a share page at `https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/mod/<id>/` that you can link from a forum post, a README or social media.
- If your mod reads files by a fixed path to `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency`, it finds nothing in a Borea instance. Use the folder of your mod, or `KSA.Constants.DocumentsFolderPath`, instead.

#### Command line

- `borea update-self` updates Borea, and `--check` only says what it would install.
- `borea game check` lists what Borea assumes about the game installation, and whether each holds.
- `borea instance show` names the mod loader an instance needs.
- `borea instance backups`, `restore-backup` and `delete-backup` work with the backups of an instance, and `borea instance take-ownership` takes over a mod you installed by hand.
- `borea instance scan --json` now prints an object with `foreignFolders` and `missingMods` instead of an array, which breaks a script that reads the array.

#### Good to know

- The builds are not code signed yet, so Windows warns on the first start. "First start" on this page says what to click.
- The macOS build runs on Apple silicon. Start it from Terminal the first time, as "First start" on this page explains.
- A translation no longer has to be complete. A text a translation does not have shows in English.
- Borea is a community project by the KSA Modding team, not made by RocketWerkz.
